title: Bench campaign (inner-loop carrier, N bench rounds)
description: Stage contract carrying the inner loop of PRECISION_GREASE_DEV: a campaign of up to max_iterations bench rounds, each round producing samples, running the screen and bench tests, assessing variance, and ending in one stop_state. Cross-field rule: current_iteration must not exceed max_iterations. Pure JSON Schema cannot compare two numbers, so that check is NOT expressed structurally here -- the validator enforces it and reports it; this description and the $comment on max_iterations record the rule for the reader (no fake constraint is invented). pairing_design exists because paired comparison (an A/B pair run in the same round and swapped in the next round) is the design this project should prefer: at a fixed sigma, pairing buys more resolution than trying to measure sigma precisely.
$comment: Cross-field rule current_iteration <= max_iterations: pure JSON Schema has no keyword that compares two instance numbers, so this rule is deliberately NOT expressed structurally and no fake if/then is invented. The validator enforces it and reports it; it is recorded here, in the top-level description, and in the $comment on max_iterations.

bench_references.description: Bench ids this campaign draws its scarce slots from.

max_iterations.description: Maximum number of bench rounds this campaign may use. Validator-enforced: current_iteration must not exceed this value.
max_iterations.$comment: Validator-enforced cross-field rule (not expressible in JSON Schema): current_iteration must be less than or equal to max_iterations.

current_iteration.description: Bench round this campaign is currently at, 1-based. Validator-enforced: must not exceed max_iterations.

iterations.description: One entry per inner-loop round actually run, oldest first. Every round records how it ended through stop_state; capped by max_iterations (validator-enforced).

samples.description: Samples run in this round, as sample references.

stop_state.description: How this round ended: CONTINUE (another round is planned), GOAL_MET, NO_NEW_INFORMATION, RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED, PIVOT or KILL. Only CONTINUE authorizes another round.

screening_reference.description: Optional screening artifact for this round (RELEASED gate into the bench).

variance_reference.description: Optional variance assessment produced from this round's runs.

model_reference.description: Optional model artifact updated from this round's results.

next_batch_reference.description: Optional next-batch reference when this round decided a follow-up batch.

bench_test_references.description: Bench test runs belonging to this round. Optional; may be empty while a round is still executing.

pairing_design.description: How samples are paired across rounds. paired=true means each A/B pair runs in the same round and is swapped in the next round, so bench-to-bench drift cancels: at a fixed sigma, pairing buys more resolution than trying to measure sigma precisely.
